about: State of a client definition beside ecl::character_creation::DefinitionStateComponent: three bytes, an array, and the pair ChangeId and NeedsSync that the sending of the definition goes by. Script Extender: ClientCCDefinitionStateEx.

evidence.says: Script Extender's header Components/CharacterCreation.h binds ClientCCDefinitionStateEx to this engine name; the offsets of ChangeId and NeedsSync are the ones its legacy field names carry
in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) the client's definition entity carries it

reported from a run of character creation, not read again here: moving ChangeId and NeedsSync by hand sends nothing, and after it the window's own list choices stop being taken until the session is restarted
